title: 2. The Misleading Shadow
description: Chapter 2 of 3 of “The Case of the Missing Star”. Read in order.

cover.alt: The Case of the Missing Star

illustration.alt: The shadow changes; they knock, and Pico opens with a lantern near a coat stand.

lines: Luna and Nico watch the huge shadow outside the workshop door.
blocks.title: At the workshop door

lines: The light moves. The shadow changes its shape too.
blocks.title: The shadow shifts

lines: Nico knocks, and Luna waits beside him.
blocks.title: Knocking

lines: Pico opens the door with a lantern. A coat stand is behind him.
blocks.title: Pico opens up

variants.retryFeedback: Notice what Pico is carrying and what stands behind him.

variants.prompt: Which question helps them check their first impression?

options.text: What object and light make the shadow
How to escape a creature they have not seen

variants.correctFeedback: That’s it! What object and light make the shadow.
variants.retryFeedback: Notice what Pico is carrying and what stands behind him.

illustration.alt: They check the coat’s shadow and discover mud and ribbon on a cart wheel.

lines: He moves the lantern. The coat's shadow changes again.
blocks.title: Moving the lantern

lines: Nico touches the purple sleeve. Just a coat, not a monster!
blocks.title: Just clothes

lines: Luna spots an orange cart with muddy wheels.
blocks.title: The orange cart

lines: Blue ribbon with white dots hangs from one wheel.
blocks.title: Ribbon on the wheel

variants.prompt: What makes the shadow beside the lantern?

options.text: A coat stand with a coat

variants.correctFeedback: That’s it! A coat stand with a coat.
variants.retryFeedback: Look for two matches: the marks on the ground and the blue fabric.

variants.prompt: What connects the cart to the trail?

options.text: Its muddy wheels and the matching ribbon

variants.correctFeedback: That’s it! Its muddy wheels and the matching ribbon.
variants.retryFeedback: Look for two matches: the marks on the ground and the blue fabric.

illustration.alt: They connect the cart’s route to the hook and uncover a yellow point beneath cloth.

lines: The long muddy lines lead right to this cart.
blocks.title: The same path

lines: Pico points towards the place where the star hung.
blocks.title: Where it hung

lines: Luna lifts a corner of the cloth covering the cart.
blocks.title: Lifting the cloth

lines: A yellow point and a purple ring peek out. What could it be?
blocks.title: What's peeking out?

variants.prompt: What peeks out beneath the cloth?

options.text: A yellow point and a purple ring

variants.correctFeedback: That’s it! A yellow point and a purple ring.
variants.retryFeedback: Only part is visible. Think about how to check the rest.

variants.prompt: What should they do before saying it is the star?

options.text: Uncover and examine the whole object

variants.correctFeedback: That’s it! Uncover and examine the whole object.
variants.retryFeedback: Only part is visible. Think about how to check the rest.

ribbon.definition: A narrow strip of fabric used for tying or decorating.

workshop.definition: A place where things are made or repaired.

shadow.definition: A dark shape made when something blocks light.

lantern.definition: A light protected by a case that can be carried.

sleeve.definition: The part of clothing that covers an arm.
